basics.name: Alexander Rios
basics.label: Backend Developer specialized in Golang and Java (Spring Boot)
basics.summary: Backend Developer specialized in Golang and Java, with experience also in TypeScript, focused on building scalable APIs, security-aware services, and distributed backend systems. I have developed authentication systems, developer tooling, and infrastructure-level services using Spring Boot, Fiber, Gin, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supported by Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux-based environments. I combine software architecture, automation, and security-oriented design to build reliable and maintainable backend platforms.

work.name: Conform Badmöbels
work.summary: Currently working as a CNC machine operator and programming the CNC, I have grown together with the company and developed expertise in various areas such as teamwork, problem-solving to achieve quick solutions, and continuous improvement of operational efficiency.
highlights: Operated and maintained CNC machinery for precision manufacturing
Collaborated with team members to optimize production workflows
Implemented process improvements to increase efficiency

awards.title: Second Place - Devathon VI
awards.summary: Achieved second place as part of team in the VI edition of Devathon, a competitive programming event focused on innovative software solutions.

projects.name: OpenCore
projects.description: A TypeScript-first multiplayer runtime and backend framework for FiveM, designed around dependency injection, strict typing, event-driven architecture, and modular resources. OpenCore provides an engineering-grade foundation for building scalable game servers and online services.

projects.name: OpenCore CLI
projects.description: Command-line tool for scaffolding, building, validating, and packaging OpenCore resources. It provides project initialization, build pipelines, deployment helpers, and developer automation for FiveM servers.

projects.name: OpenCore Identity
projects.description: Authentication and identity service for OpenCore, providing account management, roles, permissions, and session handling using a database-backed and API-driven architecture.

projects.name: Swagger for Fiber v3
projects.description: Swagger middleware for Fiber v3 that automatically exposes RESTful API documentation for Golang backends, supporting modern OpenAPI workflows.

projects.name: GoPass
projects.description: A secure, offline-first password manager written in Golang, focused on strong encryption, local vaults, and minimal attack surface.

projects.name: VaultShield
projects.description: VaultShield is a solution for secure credential management. Designed with passion during our devathon event, this platform aims to revolutionize the way teams manage their sensitive data.
